liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd_nrps70-06-24.aud.pcrp5.23062.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): audience recording; 43 songs; 242 min; rated 4.38/5 by 68 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the sound is much better than previous versions of this show; Reviewer praises the sound quality and the feeling of being in the room; Reviewer calls the audience tape exceptionally good for the era and immersive [12][15][19][20]
- **gd1970-06-24.aud.lai.7467.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 38 songs; 186 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [2]
- **gd1970-06-24.145261.late.SonyF95.lee.hance.sirmick.flac1644**: source not stated; 38 songs; 194 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1970-06-24.aud.unknown.gadsden-reynolds.100223.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 79 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer claims the Capitol Theatre energy in Port Chester was uniquely infectious [10]
- Reviewer notes the date matches their seventh birthday and cites Miami as another good show [11]
- Reviewer suggests wild New York fans directed the vibe back to the band [16]
- John found another tape to complete Silver Threads and Golden Needles [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd_nrps70-06-24.aud.pcrp5.23062.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Ken & Judy Lee; transferred by John Jay Hance, Peter G; source: Audience [1]. Also: Taped using a Sony TC124 with unknown Sony dynamic microphones [1]
- **gd1970-06-24.aud.lai.7467.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Wayne Gucwa and Mike Lai; source: (no source info given- listeners report AUD) [2]. Also: Disc 2 contains the first acoustic set with New Riders of the Purple Sage [2]
- **gd1970-06-24.145261.late.SonyF95.lee.hance.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Ken and Judy Lee; transferred by John Hance and Sirmick; source: Source: Source: Sony F95's > Sony TC124 > Master Cassette - Recorded by Ken and Judy Lee, [3]. Also: This is a redo using original raw files, not a remaster of previous versions [3]
- **gd1970-06-24.aud.unknown.gadsden-reynolds.100223.flac16**: transferred by Bill Gadsen and Chuck Reynolds; source: Unknown Audience Source [5]. Also: Bill Gadsden performed the analog to digital transfer in April 2009; New Riders tracks were speed corrected by plus 0.8 percent [5]
